values: 一名可变成石像形态的战士，拥有快速恢复生命值的能力。
A Warrior who can turn into stone and quickly recover HP.
I fear I can no longer stay...
It's been too long, my friend.
思维不能僵硬，身体也不能
The mind must remain supple, as must the body.
很高兴你还记得我的喜好，我真的很喜欢它。
I'm touched you recalled my partiality for this.
谢谢，如果你挑选礼物的本领和你的魔法水平一样出众，就更好了。
Thank you. If only your taste were as potent as your magic.
是石像，是秘密，也是守护者。
A silent statue bound to protect a hidden fate.
There are many people here, but it is rather interesting.
有意思，这里是梅林设计的吗？
Interesting. Did Merlin design this place?
“佐尔娅”并非她的真名，也不是唯一的名字，只是她用过的众多名字中，她自己觉得最好听的那一个。
Zorya isn't her real name. It's simply her favorite from a long list of names she's used.
佐尔娅目前是“怪物与恶魔学”的教师。在这之前，她教过幻术魔法、炼金魔法、力场魔法、元素魔法……除了预言占卜之外，她几乎什么都擅长。
Zorya currently teaches Monsters & Hypogeans. Before that, she's covered Illusion Magic, Alchemy, Forcefield Magic, Elemental Magic... almost anything besides Divination.
刚入校任教时，佐尔娅教授的课程是幻术魔法。但由于她的石像鬼造型和诡异的幻术魔法过于相得益彰，在课堂上吓晕了不少学生，校长不得已更换了她的课程。

When she first joined the academy, Zorya taught Illusion Magic, until the headmaster had no choice but to reassign her after her gargoyle-like appearance and unsettling illusions freaked quite a few students out.
佐尔娅有自己的审美和格调，她现在的石像身体是从自己收集的467尊石像中精挑细选出来的，因为她觉得这尊石像最能体现她本人的气质。
Zorya has her very own sense of style. Her current gargoyle body is handpicked from her personal collection of 467 statues because it "captures her essence best".
在莱希拉姆，佐尔娅长期位列学生私下评选的“十大最佳教师”之首和“十大恐怖传说”之首。前者是因为她渊博的知识与精准深刻的授课方式，后者则是因为她的样貌和神出鬼没的行动习惯。

Zorya has consistently ranked No. 1 on both unofficial "Best Professors" and "Scariest Tales". The first comes from her depth of knowledge and brilliant teaching while the second, her face and her habit of popping out of nowhere.
“佐尔娅只是看上去很冷漠。每年她都会资助不少家庭条件不好的学生，只不过她从不对别人说，连受助人自己都不知道。”——雷蒙校长对佐尔娅的评价。
"People mistake Zorya for cold. Actually, she funds students who can't afford tuition every year and does it so discreetly that the beneficiaries remain none the wiser." —Leymar
作为亡灵，佐尔娅并不用进食。但为了伪装与合群，她还是会偶尔和同事一起喝下午茶。还好“受苦”的是她的石像载体，不是她的本体。
As a Graveborn, Zorya doesn't need food. Still, she'll sometimes sit in on afternoon tea with the other professors to blend in. Luckily, it's her gargoyle body that handles all the "sufferings".
很少人知道佐尔娅的石像身体五音不全，或许这是因为工匠在雕刻石像的时候总是会忽略发音器官的结构正确性吧。
Few know Zorya sings off-key due to her gargoyle body. Perhaps most artisans don't prioritize the finer details of vocal anatomy.
在所有“人类发明的消遣”中，佐尔娅最喜欢的是阅读侦探小说。对佐尔娅来说，比起程序正义，结果更重要——这正与侦探小说的核心一致。
Of all the "pastimes humans have created", Zorya enjoys detective novels most. She cares less for due process than for the truth, a mindset that fits the genre perfectly.
作为魔法师协会的一员，佐尔娅是现任梅林最信任的朋友之一。在梅林失忆之前她就以“贝狄威尔”的身份驻守赛凡纳大区，承担着维护地区稳定的重要责任。

As a member of the Arcane Council, Zorya is one of the current Merlin's most trusted friends. Even before Merlin's memory loss, she was stationed in the Savannah under the name Bedivere, responsible for maintaining order across the region.
墓园中的长眠者们，其生前的非凡故事，多已隐入尘封的卷册内。
Many of those buried here once led extraordinary lives, but time has tucked their stories away in forgotten books and brittle scrolls.

values.text: It was crowded, but also very interesting.

values: 一位亡灵女士，一尊雕像，一只蝙蝠。看来你就是这个世界上最伟大的魔法师——梅林——的导师了。
A Graveborn lady, a stone golem, and a bat. I assume that makes you the mentor of the world's greatest mage, Merlin.
